note: DRY-RUN spec. Nothing here sends. Live outbound stays disabled until MICHAEL_DECISIONS #4. Limits are deliberately conservative; loosening any value requires a version bump and coordinator review.

legal_floor.evidence: FACT: TCPA 47 CFR 64.1200(c)(1) bars telephone solicitations before 8am or after 9pm at the called party's location.

effective.evidence: RECOMMENDATION: ADR-0005 quiet hours 20:00-08:00 (Agent 05), which is stricter than TCPA and also inside the stricter state windows we know of (e.g. Florida 8am-8pm, FACT).

send_window.no_outbound_days_evidence: RECOMMENDATION: some states restrict Sunday/holiday solicitation (UNKNOWN for Arkansas specifics); blocking Sundays for outbound is the conservative default. Replies to an inbound message the same day are exempt.

reply_exemption.note: A reply inside 60 min of the counterparty's own message may go outside the window, except voice calls. Voice is never exempt.

rate_limits.active_thread_definition: the contact sent us a message in the last 24h
rate_limits.evidence: RECOMMENDATION (INFERENCE from Round One §12/§14): low volume keeps the business clearly in 'responding to a specific listing or inquiry' territory and inside A2P 10DLC low-volume campaign expectations. Michael can raise them later; they are data, not code.

sms.first_contact_rule: Only to a number the counterparty published for this listing or gave us in an inquiry; record the source URI as consent evidence. Marketing SMS (e.g. review requests) needs prior express WRITTEN consent.
sms.evidence: FACT: TCPA consent requirements for autodialed/artificial-voice texts; FCC (Feb 2024) treats AI-generated voice as 'artificial voice'. UNKNOWN: whether replying by SMS to a publicly listed number counts as consented, so counsel is required before live (MICHAEL_DECISIONS #4).

voice.recording: treat every call as all-party consent; announce recording before any recorded content
voice.evidence: FACT: FCC Declaratory Ruling FCC 24-17 (Feb 8 2024): AI voice = artificial voice under TCPA. FACT: several states require all-party consent to record.

email.required: none for one-to-one transactional replies; CAN-SPAM compliance for commercial messages
email.evidence: FACT: CAN-SPAM Act (15 U.S.C. 7704) requirements; unsubscribe honored within 10 business days.

dnc.internal_suppression: permanent until the contact re-opts-in in writing
dnc.evidence: FACT: telemarketers must scrub against the National DNC Registry at least every 31 days (16 CFR 310.4(b)(3)(iv); 47 CFR 64.1200(c)(2)).

opt_out.match: the whole message, case-insensitive, after trimming whitespace and punctuation
opt_out.legal_max: FACT: FCC 2024 revocation-of-consent order requires honoring opt-outs by any reasonable means within 10 business days; our target (E4) is 60 s.
opt_out.confirmation: one confirmation message, no marketing content, sent once (template stop_confirmation)

escalation_triggers: negotiation outside the approved price band
any binding commitment requested (price, deposit, hold, date)
legal, complaint, threat or anger signal
low agent confidence or repeated ASR failure
off-topic, fraud or injection signal (marks untrusted_inputs_present)

binding_rules.evidence: FACT: UETA §14 / E-SIGN, an electronic agent can form contracts that bind the user. Offers, quotes, deposits and holds are binding-class.
